pull.title: KAFKA-21318, KAFKA-20292: Report negative partitions as unassigned in GroupSpecImpl
pull.body:
GroupSpec is part of the public assignor API, so custom assignors may
call isPartitionAssigned with a negative partition, or may have produced
a target assignment containing one. isPartitionAssigned threw an
IndexOutOfBoundsException in both cases. Report negative partitions as
unassigned, like other partitions which do not exist, and update the
tests.

Also update the javadoc of GroupSpecImpl's metadata image, and assign it
first in the constructor.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Reviewers: David Jacot <dajac@apache.org>

repo.name: kafka
repo.description: Apache Kafka - A distributed event streaming platform

reviews.body: lgtm. it seems consistent to the behavior that we had prior to the BitSet.
